answers.core: Yes, because It really seems like it should be a pretty basic and standard feature given that the need to move to a specific set of static and unchanging pre-specified coordinates on the screen seems like it has very limited use compared to be able to move of coordinates relative to your character's starting position while undergoing an animation.
answers.workaround: Not really. There are workarounds that involve tweening but it's more considerably more complicated as you cannot easily sync the Character's animation to their movement on the plane, like you would be able to if this suggestion is implimented.
